name: recoder
description: AI-powered development platform with production-ready code generation

scripts.install:packages: npm-run-all --parallel install:shared install:cli install:router install:analytics install:intelligence install:plugins install:security install:web-ai
scripts.install:platforms: npm-run-all --parallel install:web install:chat install:mobile install:desktop install:extension install:browser-extension
scripts.build:all: npm-run-all --parallel build:shared build:packages build:core && npm-run-all --parallel build:web build:chat build:mobile build:desktop build:extension build:browser-extension
scripts.build:packages: npm-run-all --parallel build:cli build:router build:analytics build:intelligence build:plugins build:security build:web-ai
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && pnpm build || echo 'Backend build not configured'
scripts.build:mobile: cd recoder-chat-mobile && pnpm run build || npx expo export -p web
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "pnpm run dev:backend" "pnpm run dev:engine" "pnpm run dev:web" "pnpm run dev:chat" "pnpm run dev:mobile" "pnpm run dev:desktop" "pnpm run dev:collaboration" --names "backend,engine,web,chat,mobile,desktop,collab" --prefix-colors "blue,green,magenta,yellow,cyan,red,white"
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && pnpm dev || node src/server.js
scripts.dev:engine: cd production-engine && pnpm dev || node src/server.js
scripts.dev:mobile: cd recoder-chat-mobile && pnpm start || npx expo start
scripts.dev:desktop: cd recoder-desktop && pnpm dev || npm run dev
scripts.start:backend: cd backend && npm start || node src/server.js
scripts.start:engine: cd production-engine && npm start || node dist/server.js
scripts.test:platforms: npm-run-all --parallel test:web test:chat test:mobile test:desktop test:extension test:browser-extension
scripts.test:cli: cd packages/cli && pnpm test || echo 'CLI tests not configured'
scripts.test:router: cd packages/recoder-cli-router && pnpm test || echo 'Router tests not configured'
scripts.test:shared: cd packages/shared && pnpm test || echo 'Shared tests not configured'
scripts.test:backend: cd backend && pnpm test || echo 'Backend tests not configured'
scripts.test:engine: cd production-engine && pnpm test || echo 'Engine tests not configured'
scripts.test:web: cd recoder-web && pnpm test || echo 'Web platform tests not configured'
scripts.test:chat: cd recoder-chat && pnpm test || echo 'Chat platform tests not configured'
scripts.test:extension: cd recoder-extension/src && pnpm test || echo 'Extension tests not configured'
scripts.test:mobile: cd recoder-chat-mobile && pnpm test || echo 'Mobile tests not configured'
scripts.test:desktop: cd recoder-desktop && pnpm test || echo 'Desktop tests not configured'
scripts.test:browser-extension: cd browser-extension && echo 'Browser extension tests not configured'
scripts.test:full: pnpm run build && pnpm run test:integration
scripts.lint:platforms: npm-run-all --parallel lint:web lint:chat lint:extension lint:mobile lint:desktop lint:browser-extension
scripts.lint:cli: cd packages/cli && pnpm lint || echo 'CLI lint not configured'
scripts.lint:router: cd packages/recoder-cli-router && pnpm lint || echo 'Router lint not configured'
scripts.lint:shared: cd packages/shared && pnpm lint || echo 'Shared lint not configured'
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && pnpm lint || echo 'Backend lint not configured'
scripts.lint:engine: cd production-engine && pnpm lint || echo 'Engine lint not configured'
scripts.lint:web: cd recoder-web && pnpm lint || echo 'Web platform lint not configured'
scripts.lint:chat: cd recoder-chat && pnpm lint || echo 'Chat platform lint not configured'
scripts.lint:extension: cd recoder-extension/src && pnpm lint || echo 'Extension lint not configured'
scripts.lint:mobile: cd recoder-chat-mobile && pnpm lint || echo 'Mobile lint not configured'
scripts.lint:desktop: cd recoder-desktop && pnpm lint || echo 'Desktop lint not configured'
scripts.lint:browser-extension: cd browser-extension && echo 'Browser extension lint not configured'
scripts.typecheck:platforms: npm-run-all --parallel typecheck:web typecheck:chat typecheck:extension typecheck:mobile typecheck:desktop typecheck:browser-extension
scripts.typecheck:cli: cd packages/cli && pnpm typecheck || echo 'CLI typecheck not configured'
scripts.typecheck:router: cd packages/recoder-cli-router && pnpm typecheck || echo 'Router typecheck not configured'
scripts.typecheck:shared: cd packages/shared && pnpm typecheck || echo 'Shared typecheck not configured'
scripts.typecheck:backend: cd backend && pnpm typecheck || echo 'Backend typecheck not configured'
scripts.typecheck:engine: cd production-engine && pnpm typecheck || echo 'Engine typecheck not configured'
scripts.typecheck:web: cd recoder-web && pnpm typecheck || echo 'Web platform typecheck not configured'
scripts.typecheck:chat: cd recoder-chat && pnpm typecheck || echo 'Chat platform typecheck not configured'
scripts.typecheck:extension: cd recoder-extension/src && pnpm check-types || echo 'Extension typecheck not configured'
scripts.typecheck:mobile: cd recoder-chat-mobile && pnpm typecheck || echo 'Mobile typecheck not configured'
scripts.typecheck:desktop: cd recoder-desktop && pnpm typecheck || echo 'Desktop typecheck not configured'
scripts.typecheck:browser-extension: cd browser-extension && echo 'Browser extension typecheck not configured'
scripts.clean:all: rimraf node_modules packages/*/node_modules recoder-*/node_modules backend/node_modules production-engine/node_modules packages/*/dist backend/dist production-engine/dist recoder-*/dist recoder-*/.next
scripts.clean:cache: rimraf .nx packages/*/.nx backend/.nx production-engine/.nx recoder-*/.nx .turbo packages/*/.turbo recoder-*/.turbo
scripts.clean:deps: rimraf node_modules packages/*/node_modules recoder-*/node_modules backend/node_modules production-engine/node_modules
scripts.clean:build: rimraf packages/*/dist backend/dist production-engine/dist packages/*/out recoder-*/dist recoder-*/.next recoder-extension/src/dist
scripts.unlink:cli: cd packages/cli && npm unlink -g || echo 'CLI not linked'
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run test && docker-compose up -d
scripts.postinstall: echo 'Run npm run setup for full setup'

author: Recoder Team
